name: ScaleUp Genius Hub — Workshop Onboarding Automation
description: Triggers when a new row is added to the Google Sheet (new registration). Sends WhatsApp via Interakt + Email via Brevo. Schedule reminders 24hr and 1hr before workshop.

flow.label: Watch new registrations
flow.note: Triggers every 15 minutes. Replace spreadsheetId with your actual Sheet ID from the URL.

flow.label: Parse registration data
flow.note: Maps spreadsheet columns to named variables. Column order: A=First Name, B=Last Name, C=Email, D=Phone (with country code, e.g. 919876543210), E=Workshop Date, F=Workshop Time, G=Zoom Link

flow.label: Send WhatsApp — Registration Confirmed
flow.note: Replace PASTE_YOUR_INTERAKT_API_KEY_HERE with your actual key from Interakt → Settings → API. Replace YOUR_NAME_HERE with your actual name.

flow.label: Send Email — Registration Confirmation
flow.note: Get your Brevo API key from Brevo → Settings → API Keys. Get templateId after creating the template in Brevo → Email → Templates.

flow.label: Add to Brevo automation list
flow.note: This adds them to the list that triggers your 7-email automation in Brevo. Create the list in Brevo → Contacts → Lists first.

flow.label: Mark as processed in Sheet
flow.note: Writes SENT in column H and the timestamp in column I so the same row doesn't trigger twice.

reminders.note: For 24hr and 1hr reminders, create TWO separate Make scenarios that run daily and check if workshop_date = tomorrow or workshop_date = today. Use the same WhatsApp API call with template names: workshop_reminder_24hr and workshop_reminder_1hr

setup_checklist: 1. Create Google Sheet using the template in google-sheet-template.md
2. Create Brevo account and get API key
3. Create email templates in Brevo (copy from email-sequence.md)
4. Create Brevo automation list and note the List ID
5. Create Interakt account and get API key
6. Submit WhatsApp templates in Interakt (copy from whatsapp-templates.md)
7. Wait for WhatsApp template approval (5-30 mins)
8. In Make, create a new scenario
9. Add Google Sheets module — Watch new rows
10. Add HTTP module for Interakt (copy JSON body from this file)
12. Add Google Sheets module to mark row as SENT
13. Set scenario to run every 15 minutes
